postings.title: C++/LLVM Team Lead
postings.description:
Summary

Guardsquare is looking for an R&D Team Lead to join us in our Leuven office and lead one of our Leuven based C++/LLVM teams.

In this role you will be responsible for a team of about 5 to 7 C++/LLVM compiler engineers working within an agile software development environment. The ideal candidate started their career technically and has a good understanding of software engineering within a high-tech start/scale-up, and grew into or is now ready for a team lead role.

Your key responsibilities will be:

- Own the results delivered by your team. You lead day-to-day development; assign tasks, track progress, ensure timely delivery and high quality.

- Mentor engineers, foster collaboration, and motivate the team to reach company and personal objectives.

- Set coding standards and best practices for maintainable solutions.

- Work with product teams to translate business needs into technical specifications.

- Implement and enforce testing practices to deliver reliable software.

- Encourage new ideas and own engineering processes to drive continuous improvement.

- Represent Guardsquare’s R&D values, its products and its culture.

Requirements:

- Masters in computer science with 5+ years of experience, of which at least 3 as a Team Lead

- Proven track record of achieving results with teams

- Experience setting performance goals and performing appraisals

- Strong programming fundamentals

- Previous experience with low level programming is an asset

- Deep knowledge of C++ is also a nice plus

- A no-nonsense and pragmatic attitude, continuously raising the bar

- Excellent English communication

- Understanding the value of in-person leadership in a hybrid work environment

What Guardsquare offers you

- A full time job with a competitive salary package

- You are provided with the tools & flexibility to develop yourself successfully

- An international environment where you will interact with motivated & open colleagues with different backgrounds

- A workplace where you can share and implement your ideas

- A hybrid work policy, which helps guarantee an excellent work-life balance

At Guardsquare, we take pride in being a diverse and multicultural company with team members representing numerous nationalities. We value different perspectives and opinions throughout the business which has contributed to our being the market leader in mobile application security.

You will be part of a dynamic team that strives for excellence and focuses on continuous education and enhancement in skills. We encourage & empower our trusted colleagues to share their opinions, actively collaborate, and continue to learn and grow.

Do you want to make a difference? What are you waiting for? Join us!

You can apply for this opportunity by filling out the application form below!

postings.title: Compiler Engineer C++/LLVM (Singapore)
postings.description:
Build software that makes reverse engineering harder

As Guardsquare expands across Asia-Pacific, we are looking for C++/LLVM Compiler Engineers with a passion for low-level engineering, compiler technology, and software security.

You will work on iXGuard and other products built on C++ and LLVM, developing technology that protects mobile applications against reverse engineering and tampering. Your work will involve improving a complex codebase, researching new code-hardening techniques, and solving challenging engineering problems where security, performance, compatibility, and binary impact all matter.

As one of our first engineers in Singapore, you will help establish and shape our local R&D presence alongside newly hired engineers and experienced colleagues relocating from our headquarters in Leuven.

Up to 50% of your role will focus on R&D Customer Support. This is not traditional helpdesk support: you will investigate, reproduce, and debug complex technical issues while working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to find robust solutions.

You will report to the local Managing Director for office-related matters and functionally to your R&D Team Lead for technical priorities, guidance, and professional development.

What You’ll Work On

- Develop and improve our C++/LLVM-based products.

- Research, test, and implement new functionalities and code-hardening techniques.

- Work with compiler internals, LLVM tools and libraries, and complex application-processing pipelines.

- Maintain and continuously improve a large, mature codebase.

- Investigate, reproduce, and debug complex technical issues.

- Help customers integrate and use our software successfully.

- Collaborate with customers and internal R&D teams to solve challenging engineering problems.

- Improve software quality through extensive testing.

- Stay ahead of developments in compiler technology, mobile application security, and reverse engineering.

What You Bring

- Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

- At least 2–3 years of relevant software engineering experience.

- Excellent C++ skills.

- Experience working with large or complex codebases.

- Knowledge of compiler internals.

- Familiarity with LLVM tools and libraries.

- Experience with low-level programming and debugging.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- The ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly and collaborate directly with customers.

- An interest in software security and reverse engineering.

Why Guardsquare?

This is not standard application development.

You will work at the intersection of compiler engineering, low-level programming, mobile security, and reverse engineering. You will solve real-world LLVM challenges, explore mobile technology stacks beyond the application layer, and help shape the products, features, and engineering practices you work with.

The technology you develop can quickly make its way into industry-leading mobile applications used by some of the world’s largest payment providers, banks, and social media companies.

We offer:

- A full-time, office-based position in our new Singapore office.

- Challenging engineering work at the forefront of software protection and reverse engineering.

- Real-world problems that will expand your C++ and LLVM expertise.

- The opportunity to help build a new R&D team from its early stages.

- An international environment focused on technical ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

- The ability to share your ideas and turn them into working solutions.

At Guardsquare, we bring together colleagues from many different backgrounds and nationalities. We value open technical discussion, different perspectives, knowledge sharing, and continuous growth.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Singapore at the time of application (Citizen, PR or EP).

Ready to make software significantly harder to reverse engineer? Join us.

Apply by completing the application form below.

- Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

- The opportunity to work alongside leading security experts and product teams.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success. You’ll work closely with prospects and customers throughout the sales processes, technical evaluations and onboarding journey, helping them understand how our solutions fit into their mobile security strategy.

You are someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with customer interaction. You can explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences and thrive in a highly collaborative, international environment.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Singapore at the time of application (Citizen, PR or EP).

So, what will you be doing all day?

- Support the Sales team during sales processes, demo’s, customer meetings, events and Proof of Concepts.

- Guide prospects and customers through onboarding and implementation processes.

- Help customers optimize their product setup and configuration to maximize value from our solutions.

- Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer journey.

- Assist with technical support and configuration-related questions in collaboration with Support and Engineering teams.

- Deliver product demos and technical presentations to both technical and executive audiences.

- Provide valuable feedback from customers and prospects back to Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing teams.

- Stay up to date with the latest developments in mobile security, reverse engineering, and application protection technologies.

- Collaborate with international teams across different regions and time zones.

This is the perfect job for someone who has

- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

- Experience in a Solutions Engineering, PreSales or similar customer-facing technical role with a SaaS or Software Product company.

- Strong coding and technical troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, both written and spoken.

- Experience working with Linux, Windows, and macOS environments.

- Familiarity with Android and/or iOS application development.

- Familiarity with Android Studio, Gradle, Xcode, and mobile build processes.

- An interest in mobile application security and cybersecurity concepts.

- The ability to communicate technical concepts confidently to developers, architects, and business stakeholders.

- A proactive mindset and strong problem-solving skills.

Nice to have

- Experience within cybersecurity or application security.

- Familiarity with our products (ProGuard, DexGuard, iXGuard, …).

- Experience with reverse engineering and commonly used tooling.

- Experience working with enterprise customers in industries such as banking, FSI, or fintech.

- Additional language skills in Mandarin/Chinese and/or Malay.

Other requirements

- Singaporean citizenship or permanent residency is required.

What Guardsquare offers you

- A full-time role with a competitive salary package and performance-based incentives.

- The opportunity to play a key role in establishing and growing Guardsquare's Singapore office, while building on an already successful and fast-growing business across the APAC region.

- The chance to make a tangible impact by helping shape our commercial presence, build lasting customer relationships, and accelerate growth in one of the world's most dynamic technology markets.

- The tools, autonomy, and flexibility to succeed, with plenty of opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.

- An international environment where you'll collaborate with talented, motivated colleagues from a wide range of cultures and backgrounds across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

At Guardsquare, we take pride in being a diverse and multicultural company with team members representing numerous nationalities. We value different perspectives and opinions throughout the business which has contributed to our being the market leader in mobile application security.

You will be part of a dynamic team that strives for excellence and focuses on continuous education and enhancement in skills. We encourage & empower our trusted colleagues to share their opinions, actively collaborate, and continue to learn and grow.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us!

About Guardsquare

Guardsquare offers the most complete approach to mobile application security on the market, delivering the highest level of protection, with ease. Guardsquare integrates seamlessly across the full development cycle, from mobile app security testing and code hardening to real-time threat detection and API security. Guardsquare provides enhanced mobile application security across the entire development process.
More than 1,000 customers worldwide across all major industries rely on Guardsquare to help them identify security risks and protect their mobile applications and SDKs against reverse engineering and tampering in the ever-evolving threat landscape.

Guardsquare is based in Leuven (Belgium) with offices in Ghent (Belgium), Boston (USA) and Munich (Germany).
